blockers.description: Required structural presentation tables were not all materialized in reports/tables/dense_full_universe_v2.
blockers.reproducibility_impact: A reviewer cannot consume all required population/split structural metrics from canonical CSV tables.
blockers.scientific_impact: No change to stored rankings or scientific results; reporting completeness is affected.
blockers.smallest_corrective_action: Regenerate structural summaries deterministically from stored Top-100 rankings using retrieval_evaluator_v3.

blockers.description: Per-model original runtime fields were not consistently materialized into a canonical runtime table.
blockers.reproducibility_impact: Original versus post-hoc performance/resource evidence is not clearly separated for every model.
blockers.scientific_impact: No effect on retrieval metrics or model selection.
blockers.smallest_corrective_action: Extract original timings from manifests/logs; label unavailable original fields NOT_RECORDED and avoid fabricating values.

blockers.description: test_lock.json contains stale pending_remote_checkpoint_verification strings despite successful checkpoint smoke evidence.
blockers.reproducibility_impact: The lock does not accurately describe the recorded verification state.
blockers.scientific_impact: Potentially material provenance ambiguity for locked TEST evidence.
blockers.smallest_corrective_action: Verify chronology and checkpoint evidence; update metadata only if the existing lock bytes/semantics are otherwise unchanged, preserving hashes and an audit record.

blockers.description: Remote scientific execution used a packaged source snapshot rather than an independently verified exact tracked checkout at the final local commit.
blockers.reproducibility_impact: Remote Git HEAD/branch/working-tree provenance is not yet proven for the execution workspace.
blockers.scientific_impact: The result-to-code identity may be unresolved unless the package manifest and remote source can reconstruct the exact source state.
blockers.smallest_corrective_action: Inspect remote task package manifests, source hashes, OWNER metadata, and execution metadata; classify RP1, RP2, or RP3 without relabeling evidence.

blockers.description: Selected BioLORD corrected embedding-cache path and content hash were not represented in a dedicated selected-cache manifest.
blockers.reproducibility_impact: The retained cache cannot yet be safely selected by corpus/model/config identity rather than filename.
blockers.scientific_impact: No change to completed metrics; reuse in Step 7.5C would be unsafe without fail-closed identity evidence.
blockers.smallest_corrective_action: Inspect remote cache manifests and create selected_biolord_cache_manifest.json with exact paths, hashes, shape, dtype, corpus, target-order, model, and config identity.

blockers.description: No final closure freeze_manifest.json links all terminology, code, model, DEV, selection, lock, TEST, structural, runtime, cache, bootstrap, and export hashes.
blockers.scientific_impact: No change to results; final release gate cannot be independently checked as one manifest.
blockers.smallest_corrective_action: Generate a hash-linked freeze manifest only after the preceding evidence checks pass.
